scripts.ground:build: rustc --edition 2024 --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --crate-type cdylib -C opt-level=3 -C lto=fat -C panic=abort -C strip=symbols ground/mask.rs -o ground/mask.wasm && chmod 644 ground/mask.wasm
scripts.objects:build: rustc --edition 2024 --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --crate-type cdylib -C opt-level=3 -C lto=fat -C panic=abort -C strip=symbols engine/objects.rs -o engine/objects.wasm && chmod 644 engine/objects.wasm
scripts.audio:build: rustc --edition 2024 --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --crate-type cdylib -C opt-level=z -C lto=fat -C panic=abort -C strip=symbols engine/audio/mod.rs -o engine/audio.wasm && chmod 644 engine/audio.wasm
